stem:
Padma stands at the same small distance in front of three mirrors. The diagram summarises the image of her face in each mirror.

Which identification is correct?

options.text: P is plane, Q is concave, R is convex.
P is convex, Q is plane, R is concave.
All three must be plane mirrors: every image is erect.
Q is convex: a larger image always means a wider view.

teacher.key_rationale: Same-size erect → plane; larger erect → concave (nearby); smaller erect → convex.
